title: Movement and parkour
robloxStudio: 0.746.0.7461269 observed on authoring workstation; recheck on replay
scenario: A player crosses an ordered three-checkpoint parkour route using standard Roblox movement. The server validates checkpoint proximity, order, elapsed time, and displacement before acknowledging progress.
expectedOutcomes: Correct ordered traversal completes the route.
Skipping or remotely claiming a checkpoint is rejected.
Impossible displacement is rejected without mutating progress.
failureCases: A missed jump requires returning to the previous platform.
A long pause expires the route attempt.
A respawn begins a fresh route attempt.
